VERIFICATION_LADDER_POSITION.name: strategic-demand test
VERIFICATION_LADDER_POSITION.PASS_does_NOT_mean: 3v3 latent strategies verified (that requires learned-specialist crossover PASS, then Share-0 / Share-Encoder preservation)

SCOPE: JOINT scripted GUARD-vs-BREACH certification of size-normalized Pole A + Pole B at team size 3, on ONE fresh n=192 seed block. Same tool, same bootstrap, same PASS criterion as the 4v4 n=192 certifications. No PPO policy is loaded. No 2v2 or 4v4 artifact is modified.
WHY_GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2_NOT_V1: SIZE_NORMALIZED_POLE_SEMANTICS_SPEC.json NORMALIZATION_1 explicitly records that V1 multi-defender stacking is a known defect at N>2. GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 is the production probe used for the 6v6 CERTIFIED demand row and for the post-V1 4v4 demand path. Spending a 3v3 V1 certification would recreate a measured defect rather than test the question.
WHY_CANONICAL_POLES_NOT_B3: B3-3 is a 4v4 confirmatory redesign after GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 failed to certify delta_A at 4v4. At 3v3 the size-normalized canonical poles have never been tested. Mixing a 4v4 pole redesign into the first 3v3 demand row would confound team-size with pole construction. Canonical size-normalized poles first; B3-class redesign only if this row fails for a documented stacking/geometry reason.
WHY_n192: 4v4 demand certification used preregistered n=192 (CONFIRMATION_N_AMENDMENT_192 / B3-3 n192). Matching that power structure makes the cross-scale demand comparison tidy and avoids a tiny pilot that leaves LCB uncertainty to chase afterward.

POLES.B: pole_B_genome(3) = OP7 + overlay min_alive_for_defender=3 (size-normalized; canonical OP7, no B2/B3 lock overlay)

GUARD.rule: ceil(N/2) defenders on the LAST ceil(N/2) indices; BREACH = BLUE_BOTH_ATTACK_V2 unchanged
